source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Considered largely unnecessary for monitoring purposes if the delivery itself went smoothly without complications arising","B":"Performed just a single time immediately following the delivery itself, with no further vital sign checks planned for the rest of the stay","C":"Checked at regular, fairly close intervals right after delivery, with the spacing between checks gradually widening as her condition stays stable","D":"Carried out in essentially the same way and frequency no matter how much time has actually passed since delivery"}}
source_row.rationale: Postpartum vital sign monitoring is generally performed frequently in the immediate postpartum period (such as every 15 minutes initially), with intervals gradually extending as the client demonstrates stability.
source_row.source_detail: Frequency of Postpartum Vital Sign Monitoring
source_row.source_name: AWHONN — Postpartum Assessment and Monitoring Standards
